summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing a Management Information Circular for its annual general and special meeting scheduled for July 16, 2026. The meeting will cover routine items: receiving audited financial statements, reappointing the auditor, setting board size at nine, electing directors, re-approving a stock option plan and a long-term incentive plan. No extraordinary special-situation transaction is announced. This is a standard procedural filing for a foreign private issuer, analogous to a proxy statement for a routine annual meeting in the US. There are no deal terms, no strategic changes, and no event-driven catalyst to monitor.
